title: Learn Italian from A1 to C1, grammar explained · Glossa
description: A free Italian course for English speakers: standard Italian from first words to C1 in 76 modules, grammar explained, feedback that says why an answer is wrong.

card.title: Italian
card.text: Standard Italian from first words to C1, with CILS, CELI and PLIDA practice papers and 13 professional specializations.

heading: Learn Italian with the grammar explained.
lead: A complete course in the standard Italian of Italy for English speakers, from pronunciation and first words to the passato remoto, register and regional Italian at C1. Each module explains its grammar directly, then practises it with exercises whose feedback says what was wrong and why.
fineprint: The whole course, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. CILS, CELI and PLIDA practice papers, specializations, stories, conversation practice and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

items.title: Tier 1 · A1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: Pronunciation and spelling, greetings, nouns and articles, essere, numbers.

items.title: Tier 2 · A1 · Everyday basics
items.text: The present of -are, -ere and -ire verbs, avere, adjectives, questions.

items.title: Tier 3 · A1–A2 · Daily life
items.text: Irregular, modal and reflexive verbs, articulated prepositions, the partitive.

items.title: Tier 4 · A2 · The past
items.text: The passato prossimo and the imperfect, object pronouns.

items.title: Tier 5 · A2–B1 · Building fluency
items.text: Ci and ne, combined pronouns, future, conditional, imperative.

items.title: Tier 6 · B1 · Intermediate
items.text: The present subjunctive, the trapassato, reported speech.

items.title: Tier 7 · B2 · Upper intermediate
items.text: The imperfect subjunctive, if-clauses, the passive and si.

items.title: Tier 8 · C1 · Advanced
items.text: The passato remoto, style, idioms, spoken and regional Italian.

sections.heading: A course that explains, then checks

items.title: Grammar taught directly
items.text: Articles and articulated prepositions, essere or avere in the passato prossimo, ci and ne and the subjunctive each get their own modules, explained in plain English before you practise them.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: Every answer gets feedback with the reason and a link to the grammar rule, and the exercises you got wrong come back at the end.

items.title: Every Italian word can be tapped
items.text: Tap any word in a lesson, exercise or text for its meaning, its forms and audio, and add it to your vocabulary.

items.title: The Italian of Italy, and its regions
items.text: The standard Italian of Italy, with modules on spoken Italian and on Italian across Italy and beyond in the last tier.

items.title: Speaking with pronunciation feedback
items.text: Speaking exercises check your pronunciation of Italian sentences, word by word.

items.title: Common traps
items.text: Short units on the mistakes English speakers make in Italian, from false friends and articles where English has none to one English verb that needs two Italian ones.

sections.heading: Practice papers for CILS, CELI and PLIDA
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers for each level of three Italian certificates, in their task formats with original content: CILS from the Università per Stranieri di Siena (A1 to C2), CELI from the Università per Stranieri di Perugia (CELI Impatto to CELI 5) and PLIDA from the Società Dante Alighieri (A1 to C2). That is 18 exams and 36 papers. They are part of Premium.
items: CILS, CELI and PLIDA practice papers: what the B1 exams ask, what the papers cover and where they differ from the real exams.

sections.heading: Italian for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen specialization courses, each with nine modules in three stages (foundations, working vocabulary and professional), which open as you reach tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the course. They are part of Premium.

items.question: Is the Italian course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 76 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free, with no limit on lessons. Premium adds the extras listed above.

items.question: Which Italian does Glossa teach?
items.answer: The standard Italian of Italy, with a module on spoken Italian and one on Italian across Italy and beyond.

items.question: I already know some Italian. Do I have to start from the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test finds the tier to start from.

items.question: How far does the course go?
items.answer: To C1: the last tier covers the passato remoto, implicit clauses, the fine points of the subjunctive, register and style, idioms and proverbs, spoken and regional Italian, history, literature and law.

items.question: Can it prepare me for an Italian certificate such as PLIDA B1 for citizenship?
items.answer: The course covers the grammar and vocabulary from A1 to C1, and Premium adds timed practice papers for every level of CILS, CELI and PLIDA, including the B1 exams. The papers have no speaking test and give no grade, so they are practice, not a prediction of your result. Which certificate an application needs is decided by the Italian authorities that handle it.

closing.heading: Start with the first module, or find your level.
closing.text: Sign in with Google, take the placement test if you already know some Italian, and open the module it suggests. Italian is also taught for Spanish speakers, in Italiano para hispanohablantes.
